composition.serve_who: This is the Freshwater System Schematic (DWG 108-01-510-001, Rev B) for the whole vessel. Upper region is a GA/deck-plan overlay showing every cabin/head/galley fixture served by the freshwater distribution (cold, hot, dedicated/watermaker, sterilized-drinking, saltwater priming and bunker lines) using frame stations 0-11 and letters A-M as cross-reference keys. The lower region is the actual schematic: two 1500L fresh water tanks (port/stbd), two freshwater pressure pumps + a dedicated pump/pressure-switch unit, two watermakers (main 230VAC + backup 24VDC), two 80L boilers/water heaters, a silver-ion steriliser, UV/carbon/calcite filtration train, bunker-line dock-fill manifold, and all cabin/head/galley/appliance fixtures fed from these sources. Evidence: title block ("FRESHWATER SYSTEM SCHEMATIC"), pipe/BOM legends defining hot/cold/dedicated/sterilized/saltwater/bunker line colors, and the authoritative Operating Modes document naming the same pumps/tanks/valves. Equipment nodes served: 510-fresh-water-pump-1, 510-fresh-water-pump-2, 510-salt-water-pump, 510-watermaker-24v, 510-ecosistems-watermaker, 511-fwd-water-heater, 511-aft-water-heater, 510-uv-steriliser, 510-water-transfer-valves, and the galley/laundry appliances (360-dishwasher, 360-washing-machine, 360-dryer) whose supply valves are shown but whose own operation is on other sheets. No dedicated 'fresh water tank' or 'fresh water system' card exists in the register other than the individual pump/heater/watermaker nodes, so the tank/manifold/distribution topology is composed onto the closest fitting system-level equipment (fresh water pumps) per the class rule, with the overall lineup captured under 510-fresh-water-pump-1/2 as the system's duty pumps.

equipment_groups.equipment_name: Fresh Water Pump 1 & 2 (pressure set) — the freshwater distribution system's duty pumps
equipment_groups.placement_reasoning: Pump Data table names 'Freshwater Pressure System' as a Gianneschi 2 Ecojet 2 BE C.E. twin-pump set (2x55 l/min, 0.37kW each) feeding the whole cabin distribution; this matches 510-fresh-water-pump-1/2 register entries. The operating-modes doc confirms these are the normal-operation supply pumps to all fixtures.

functions.label: Normal freshwater supply to all cabin/head/galley fixtures
functions.what_it_does: Draws from whichever fresh water tank (port and/or stbd, any combination) is valved open and pressurises the cold/hot/dedicated distribution mains that feed every head, galley, shower, dispenser and deck/cockpit connection shown on the upper GA overlay.

flow_scenarios.path: Port and/or Stbd 1500L tank -> Freshwater pump & pressure switch set -> cold/hot/dedicated distribution mains -> cabin distribution points (letters A-M) -> individual fixtures (heads, galley, showers, dispensers); watermakers fill tanks in parallel
Same pump/tank lineup as Mode 1, but the dedicated line is sea water instead of fresh (valve state changed at main control panel) — pumps/piping identical, only water-type source differs

Source tank (e.g. Port) -> Freshwater pump & pressure switch set (Dedicated pump OFF at breaker) -> Receiving tank (e.g. Stbd); CAUTION: monitor to avoid over-pressurising receiving tank, valves reversible for opposite direction

If both freshwater pumps inoperative, the Dedicated pump & pressure switch unit (020-01 area) takes over supply from raw water seachest / fresh water tanks to the freshwater distribution main; seachest shutoff valve closed for this mode

equipment_groups.placement_reasoning: This item is labelled '"DEDICATED" PUMP & PRESSURE SWITCH UNIT' (item 002-01) distinct from the freshwater pressure pump set; it feeds the dedicated (sea water or watermaker-fed) line per the Pump Data table (Gianneschi Idromix Ecojet 2 BB, 55 l/min). No dedicated node exists for this pump in the register; closest fit by function (valve/line-selection logic for dockside/tank/dedicated lineups) is 510-water-transfer-valves, used here as a placeholder attach — flagged as uncertain fit.

functions.label: Dedicated-line supply / backup pump duty
functions.what_it_does: Feeds the 'dedicated line' (sea water in normal/economical modes, fresh water in some configurations) and serves as backup pump for the freshwater set when both main pumps are down.

flow_scenarios.path: Raw water seachest (ref DWG 108-01-515-001) -> Dedicated pump & pressure switch unit -> dedicated distribution line -> anchor wash, deck wash, misc. dedicated-line fixtures

Fresh water tanks or seachest -> Dedicated pump (acting as backup) -> Freshwater pump & pressure switch set line, replacing the two main pumps when both are non-operational; seachest shutoff closed if using tank source

infrastructure.system_name: Fresh Water Distribution & Storage (Port/Stbd 1500L tanks, cabin distribution manifolds, cold/hot/dedicated/sterilized/saltwater/bunker mains)
facts: Two 1500L fresh water tanks (Port and Stbd) with level indicator (LI) and level transducer (LT) instrumentation per tank, tank-connection legend defines horizontal/vertical/tank-I.D. entry conventions.

Pipe legend defines seven distinct line colors/types: hot water, mixed H/C water, dedicated, sterilized drinking water, sea water, bunker line, boiler heater line — each a physically separate piped system sharing the sheet, not to be merged.
Cabin distribution points (multiple, cross-referenced 'see schematic for more details') tap the mains at each frame station (A-M) to feed heads/galley/showers throughout the vessel.
Bunker line runs in the sheer from a dock water inlet connection through a distribution manifold near the engine room to fill either tank via silver-ion sterilizer (Operating Mode 3).

Anchor bay has its own hot/cold mixer connection and separate chainwash connection, each fed via dashed through-hull risers run in the sheer from aft — separate small runs, not part of the main cabin distribution.
All transom & lazarette shutoff valves are grouped at a single location per drawing note (frame ~9-10, bottom of upper GA).
Filtration train (5-micron particle filter, carbon filter 032-01, calcite filter 033-01) sits upstream of cabin distribution / dedicated pump loop in the engine room.
Diaphragm accumulators (025-01, 025-02) fitted near the owners-head/FWD guest-head hot & cold branches to dampen pressure pulses.
Detail view: shower rose supply pipe routing from mixer uses SpeedFit 15mm insulated pipe run through partitions per E-R vent conduit detail (scale 1:2), mirrored port/stbd for aft guest showers.

Item tags 004-0X repeated across many generic supply valves — exact per-instance BOW numbers readable on full-res drawing.

Filter cartridge micron ratings / carbon-calcite filter capacities — on BOM.
uncertainties: Two physically separate 80L boiler instances are drawn (item tags overlap as 003-01/003-02 in different places) — the sheet's own established alias resolves FWD vs AFT boiler identity, but which specific drawn instance (fwd-cabin-zone vs port-lazarette-zone boiler) is the '003-01' vs '003-02' tag could not be confirmed with full certainty from this extraction; functionally both are captured but exact tag-to-node mapping should be confirmed against the BOM.

Silver Ion Sterilizer's attachment to register node 510-uv-steriliser is a functional best-fit (disinfection stage) rather than a name match — sheet calls it 'silver ion', register node is named 'UV Steriliser'; if these are actually two different technologies/devices, a dedicated node may be needed.

'Dedicated' Pump & Pressure Switch Unit (item 002-01) has no exact matching register node; attached to 510-water-transfer-valves as the closest functional fit (valve/line-selection & backup pump duty) but this is not a confident identity match — engineer should confirm whether this pump needs its own node.
